children: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP (“SBS”), a national shareholder rights litigation firm, announces that it is investigating claims on behalf of investors of Clearwater Paper Corporation (“Clearwater” or “the Company”) (
) for violations of the securities laws.

The investigation focuses on whether the Company issued false and/or misleading statements and/or failed to disclose information pertinent to investors. Clearwater released its Q3 2026 financial results on October 26, 2026. The Company revealed severe disruptions at its mill in August, Georgia caused by equipment failures. The Company also announced the resignation of its CFO. Based on this news, shares of Clearwater fell by almost 28.8% on the same day.
If you are a shareholder who suffered a loss, click here to participate.
